title: Reservation and Eligibility Terms by Storage Rental Product
content:
Every Storage Rental product requires an active lease; each product also sets its own reservation fee, hold period for move-in and limit on rentals per lease.

## Who may rent the product

| Storage Rental product | Lease status required | Floor plan requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | Active | None |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | Active | None |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | Active | None |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | Active | None |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | Active | None |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | Active | At least 2 bedrooms |

## Reservation and move-in terms

| Storage Rental product | Reservation fee | Hold for move-in (calendar days) | Reservation fee credited against the first month's rent at move-in | Signed move-in condition check | Waitlist when no unit is free | Rentals of this product per lease (maximum) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | $0.00 | 3 | Yes | No | Yes | 2 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | $0.00 | 7 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | $25.00 | 7 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | $25.00 | 7 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | $25.00 | 7 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | $50.00 | 14 | Yes | Yes | Yes | 1 |

## Reading across the rows

- **No-fee products.** The Bike Storage Locker and the Small Storage Closet (4x4) carry a $0.00 reservation fee.
- **Longest hold.** The Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) is held 14 calendar days for move-in; the Bike Storage Locker 3; every other product 7.
- **Condition check.** Every Storage Rental product except the Bike Storage Locker has a signed move-in condition check.
- **Two of one product.** The Bike Storage Locker is the only product of which one lease may hold two rentals; for each of the other five products the maximum is one.
- **Credit at move-in.** For all six products the reservation fee is credited against the first month's rent at move-in.
